provider: GeckoTerminal public API v2 (keyless) + CoinGecko on-chain DEX API (/api/v3/onchain, Demo/Pro keys) + CoinGecko WebSocket (stream.coingecko.com)
summary:
Status on 2026-09-28: the GeckoTerminal keyless API (https://api.geckoterminal.com/api/v2) is up, still labelled "v2-beta", and serves real Solana data. I live-tested it for network=solana. It covers most of ORBYT's read-only market data: trending/new/top pools, pool and token market data, token info (holder count and top-10/11-20/21-40 distribution, GT score, mint/freeze authority, dev holding %, socials, image, launchpad graduation %), 1m/5m/15m/1h/4h/12h/1d candles, and the last 300 trades of a pool. new_pools includes pump.fun bonding-curve pools (dex id "pump-fun"), meteora-dbc, pumpswap, meteora-damm-v2, stonkfun, etc. pools/multi (up to 30 addresses) returns launchpad_details.graduation_percentage for bonding pools, which is enough to build a Final Stretch view.

Headline limits:
(1) The keyless rate limit is tiny, about 10 calls/min per IP. The swagger says it "may fluctuate". I observed 429s after only 5-6 calls in about 40 s, and there are no rate-limit headers.
(2) Data is 30-45 s stale. It is cached at the origin, with Cache-Control max-age=30 and s-maxage=60 (30 for trades). The newest trade was 33 s old and the newest new pool 40-44 s old when fetched.
(3) Solana launches fill a 20-row new_pools page in about 12-30 s, and there are at most 10 pages. With 10 req/min the keyless API cannot keep a real-time Pulse feed.
(4) Second-level OHLCV, megafilter, trending_search, top_holders, holders_chart, top_traders, token-level trades, wallet trades/PnL and the WebSocket streams all need a paid CoinGecko plan (Analyst $129/mo for most; WebSocket Basic $35/mo and up).
(5) The keyless api.coingecko.com /onchain returns 401. The Demo key (free, 100 calls/min but only 10k calls/month) works on the same public endpoint set.
(6) There is no swap-quote, wallet-portfolio (Solana) or holder-list endpoint on the free tiers.

Best use for ORBYT: call GeckoTerminal directly from the browser (CORS is *, so each user gets their own IP quota) for Discover, token pages, candles and snapshot trades. Put CoinGecko Analyst+ behind Next.js route handlers for Pulse (megafilter sorted by pool_created_at_desc), holders, top traders and token trades. Streaming (OnchainTrade/OnchainOHLCV) needs a paid key and a persistent relay, not Vercel functions.

Fixtures: 35 trimmed real responses are in tests/fixtures/geckoterminal/. Each file carries a top-level "_fixture_meta" key (url, status, fetched_at, headers) that tests should strip. The docs site apiguide.geckoterminal.com now returns 403 "organization has been suspended". The authoritative docs are the swagger at https://api.geckoterminal.com/docs/v2/swagger.json and docs.coingecko.com (llms.txt index).
auth:
GeckoTerminal public (https://api.geckoterminal.com/api/v2):
- No key needed.
- Recommended header Accept: application/json;version=20230203. The swagger says the current version is 20230203; the 20230302 value from the brief was also accepted.
- Unversioned requests get the latest version.

CoinGecko on-chain, Demo plan:
- Base https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/onchain.
- Header x-cg-demo-api-key (or query x_cg_demo_api_key).
- Free signup: 10k calls/month, 100 calls/min.
- Same endpoint set as the public GT API.
- Keyless calls to this host return 401: "Requests without API key are not allowed for this endpoint" (verified).

CoinGecko on-chain, paid plans:
- Base https://pro-api.coingecko.com/api/v3/onchain.
- Header x-cg-pro-api-key (or query x_cg_pro_api_key).
- Keyless call returns 401 {"status":{"error_code":10002,"error_message":"API Key Missing"}} (verified).
- Plans: Basic $35/mo (100k credits, 300/min); Analyst $129/mo (500k credits, 500/min, unlocks the analyst_above endpoints); Lite $499 (2M, 500/min); Pro $999 (5M, 1000/min); Enterprise custom.
- 1 credit per HTTP 200. Failed calls cost no credits but do count toward the per-minute limit.
- A Pro key on api.coingecko.com gives error 10010; a Demo key on pro-api gives 10011.

WebSocket:
- wss://stream.coingecko.com/v1?x_cg_pro_api_key=KEY (or header x-cg-pro-api-key).
- Basic plan and above only.

Suggested env vars (server-only, never NEXT_PUBLIC_):
- COINGECKO_API_KEY
- COINGECKO_API_PLAN = keyless | demo | basic | analyst | pro. Pick host and header from the plan: keyless → api.geckoterminal.com/api/v2 with no key; demo → api.coingecko.com/api/v3/onchain + x-cg-demo-api-key; everything else → pro-api.coingecko.com/api/v3/onchain + x-cg-pro-api-key.
- Optional: GECKOTERMINAL_API_BASE=https://api.geckoterminal.com/api/v2, COINGECKO_WS_URL=wss://stream.coingecko.com/v1, GECKOTERMINAL_API_VERSION=20230203.
- The only browser-safe value is NEXT_PUBLIC_GECKOTERMINAL_API_BASE, for keyless client-side calls.
cors:
Browser calls to the GT public API work directly.
- Every 200/400/401 response from api.geckoterminal.com, when an Origin is sent, carried: access-control-allow-origin: *, access-control-allow-methods: GET, access-control-max-age: 7200, and vary: Accept, Origin, accept-encoding.
- Accept: application/json;version=20230203 is a CORS-safelisted header value, so there is no preflight.
- The 429 rate-limit response has NO access-control-allow-origin header. A browser fetch therefore fails with an opaque CORS/TypeError instead of a readable 429. Treat a network TypeError from this host as "rate limited" and back off.
- api.coingecko.com /onchain keyless 401 carried ACAO *.
- pro-api.coingecko.com: the preflight OPTIONS returned 200 with ACAO *, access-control-allow-headers: x-cg-pro-api-key, max-age 7200. The keyless 401 GET had no ACAO.
- A browser could technically send a pro key, but the key would be public. Keep keyed calls in Next.js route handlers.
- Because of vary: Origin, CDN cache entries are per-Origin, so all orbytai.org visitors share one Cloudflare cache entry per URL.
rate_limits:
GeckoTerminal public (keyless):
- The swagger says "approximately 10 calls/minute, which may fluctuate based on network traffic". It is per IP.
- Observed: 429 on the 6th call within ~38 s (7 s gaps). Gaps of 12-13 s (about 5/min) passed. Later 429s continued for over 2 minutes of idle, probably from shared-IP traffic by other processes on this machine.
- No X-RateLimit-* headers. The 429 has Retry-After: 0 (useless) and cache-control private, no-store.
- 429 body: {"status":{"error_code":429,"error_message":"You've exceeded the Rate Limit. ..."}}. All requests, including 4xx, count.
- A repeat of the same URL 3 s after a MISS came back cf-cache-status: HIT, age: 3, in 27 ms. Whether edge HITs count toward the limit is unverified.
- Vercel functions egress from shared cloud IPs, so keyless calls from the server are unreliable. Call from the browser, or use a key.

Cache headers:
- Most GT endpoints: Cache-Control: max-age=30, public, must-revalidate, s-maxage=60.
- Trades: s-maxage=30.
- Errors (400/401): cf-cache-status BYPASS.

CoinGecko keyed plans:
- Demo: 100 calls/min, 10k calls/month.
- Basic: 300/min, 100k/month. Analyst: 500/min, 500k. Lite: 500/min, 2M. Pro: 1000/min, 5M.
- Documented cache on paid plans: 10 s for pool/pools-multi/token/OHLCV; 30 s for trending/new/top/search lists; 0 (real-time) for pool trades and simple price; 60 s for info, holders, top traders and PnL; 30 s for megafilter.
- Documented cache on public/Demo: 60 s.

WebSocket:
- 5 concurrent sockets on Basic, 10 on Analyst+.
- 100 pool/token subscriptions per channel per socket.
- 0.1 credit per message received.
- Server pings every 10 s and drops the connection if no pong within 20 s.

endpoints.name: Trending pools by network
endpoints.purpose: Discover table and trending ticker. Ranking mixes GT user engagement, volume/transactions and pool security.
endpoints.response_shape:
data[] (20 per page, no links/meta):
- id "solana_<poolAddress>", type "pool".
- attributes: address; name "BASE / QUOTE"; pool_created_at (ISO-8601 UTC, seconds, 'Z').
- Prices (all strings, arbitrary precision): base_token_price_usd; base_token_price_native_currency (in SOL); quote_token_price_usd; quote_token_price_native_currency; base_token_price_quote_token; quote_token_price_base_token.
- fdv_usd (string); market_cap_usd (string or null; null unless CoinGecko-verified, so fall back to fdv_usd).
- price_change_percentage.{m5,m15,m30,h1,h6,h24}: string, percent units.
- transactions.{m5,m15,m30,h1,h6,h24}.{buys,sells,buyers,sellers}: int.
- volume_usd.{m5,m15,m30,h1,h6,h24}: string USD.
- reserve_in_usd: string USD liquidity.
- relationships: base_token.data.id "solana_<mint>"; quote_token.data.id; dex.data.id (e.g. "pumpswap").

included[]:
- type token: attributes {address, name, symbol, decimals (int), image_url, coingecko_coin_id|null}.
- type dex: attributes {name}.

List endpoints do NOT include pool_name, pool_fee_percentage, locked_liquidity_percentage or launchpad_details.
endpoints.params_limits: duration 5m/1h/6h/24h (default 24h). 20 per page. page max 10 on public/Demo/Basic; beyond needs Analyst. include: base_token, quote_token, dex.

endpoints.name: New pools by network
endpoints.purpose: Pulse 'New Pairs' column; also shows migration pools as they are created.
endpoints.response_shape:
Same pool list shape as trending_pools (data[], included[]). Sorted by pool_created_at desc.

One observed page contained dex ids: pump-fun (bonding curve), meteora-dbc (bonding curve), pumpswap, meteora-damm-v2, meteora, stonkfun.

Bonding pools show small reserve_in_usd (e.g. 3180 USD) and market_cap_usd null.

meteora-dbc and meteora-damm-v2 pools for the same token can appear at the same second. After a migration, the old DBC pool shows reserve_in_usd "0.0" and a tiny fdv.
endpoints.params_limits: Pools created within the past 48 h. 20 per page, max 10 pages on public/Demo/Basic (Analyst+ for more). Verified: 20 rows spanned only 12-31 s of Solana launches, so 10 pages is about 2-5 minutes of history. Does NOT return launchpad_details.
endpoints.freshness: Newest pool_created_at was 40 s old at fetch (20:45:05 vs 20:45:45, MISS) and 43.6 s old in a second run. Public cache 60 s; paid 30 s.

endpoints.name: Specific pool by address
endpoints.purpose: Token trade page header stats: price, MC/FDV, liquidity, buy/sell counts, buy/sell volume.
endpoints.response_shape:
data.attributes: all list fields, plus:
- pool_name.
- pool_fee_percentage (string|null; null for pumpswap).
- locked_liquidity_percentage (string, updated daily).
- launchpad_details (bonding pools only): {graduation_percentage number 0-100, completed bool, completed_at ISO-with-ms|null, migrated_destination_pool_address|null}.

include_volume_breakdown=true adds buy_volume_usd, sell_volume_usd and net_buy_volume_usd, each .{m5,m15,m30,h1,h6,h24} as USD strings.

include_composition=true adds:
- base_token_balance (decimal-adjusted token units string, e.g. "46747372.785993").
- base_token_liquidity_usd.
- quote_token_balance (e.g. "354.987510031" SOL).
- quote_token_liquidity_usd.

included[]: tokens and dex as in the list endpoints.
endpoints.params_limits: include: base_token, quote_token, dex. Unknown addresses are ignored.

endpoints.name: Multiple pools by addresses
endpoints.purpose: Batch refresh of Discover/Pulse rows. The only cheap way to get bonding-curve graduation % for many pools, which drives Final Stretch.
endpoints.response_shape:
data[] uses the full pool-detail attribute set (pool_name, pool_fee_percentage, locked_liquidity_percentage).

launchpad_details is present for launchpad pools, e.g.:
- pump-fun: {graduation_percentage 0, completed false}
- meteora-dbc: {graduation_percentage 100, completed true, completed_at "2026-09-28T20:44:56.000Z", migrated_destination_pool_address "37yEq..."}
- stonkfun: 0.09
- pump-fun xmrpad: 5.92

included[] as usual. Order follows the request but unknown addresses are dropped, so match by id.
endpoints.params_limits: Max 30 addresses on keyless (verified). 31 returns HTTP 400 {"errors":[{"status":"400","title":"maximum 30 addresses allowed"}],"meta":{"ref_id":uuid}}. Docs: 50 on Analyst+.

endpoints.name: Top pools by network
endpoints.purpose: Discover 'Top volume' and 'most transactions' tabs.
endpoints.response_shape: Pool list shape. Observed top rows: SOL/USDC orca (vol24 ~232.9M USD), hippo/acc/SOL pumpswap, VAULT/SOL pumpswap, SOL/USDC raydium-clmm.
endpoints.params_limits: sort h24_tx_count_desc (default) or h24_volume_usd_desc. 20 per page, max 10 pages (Analyst+ for more).

endpoints.name: Top pools by DEX
endpoints.purpose: Per-launchpad or per-AMM boards. dex=pump-fun gives active bonding curves; pumpswap, raydium-launchlab, meteora-dbc and letsbonk-fun give graduated or migrated boards.
endpoints.response_shape: Pool list shape. With dex=pump-fun: rows like "DIAMOND / SOL", reserve_in_usd = bonding-curve SOL reserve in USD (can be "0.0"), transactions.h24 counts. No launchpad_details; call pools/multi for graduation %.
endpoints.params_limits: sort only h24_tx_count_desc (default) or h24_volume_usd_desc. No created-at sort. 20 per page, 10 pages.

endpoints.name: Supported DEXes on Solana
endpoints.purpose: DEX id map for labels and filters.
endpoints.response_shape:
data[] {id, type "dex", attributes.name}. links {first, prev, next, last} (one page).

The 35 Solana ids: raydium, orca, raydium-clmm, fluxbeam, meteora, dexlab, daos-fun, pumpswap, virtuals-solana, boop-fun, saros-amm, meteora-dbc, byreal, pancakeswap-v3-solana, meteora-damm-v2, raydium-launchlab, pump-fun, saros-dlmm, wavebreak, heaven, token-mill, defituna, moonit, humidifi, zora, bags-fm, moonshot, clanker-solana, printr-v2, manifest, metadao, zerofi, easya-kickstart, stonkfun, letsbonk-fun.

There is no separate raydium-cpmm or meteora-damm(v1) id; they are presumably folded into raydium/meteora (UNCERTAIN).
endpoints.params_limits: single page

endpoints.name: Token data by address
endpoints.purpose: Token-level price, FDV, total liquidity and 24h volume. Resolves a mint to its top pools.
endpoints.response_shape:
data.attributes:
- address, name, symbol, decimals, image_url, coingecko_coin_id|null.
- total_supply: raw base units string, e.g. "1000000000000000.0".
- normalized_total_supply: decimal-adjusted, e.g. "1000000000.0".
- price_usd, fdv_usd.
- total_reserve_in_usd: this token's side only, across all its pools.
- volume_usd.h24 (only h24).
- market_cap_usd|null.
- launchpad_details (launchpad tokens).

relationships.top_pools.data[] {id "solana_<pool>", type pool} (3 observed).

included[] pools with composition fields plus token_price_usd.
endpoints.params_limits: include: top_pools only.

endpoints.name: Tokens multi
endpoints.purpose: Batch token prices, FDV and liquidity for watchlists and portfolio valuation.
endpoints.response_shape:
data[] uses the token-data shape. included[] holds top pools. Verified with 4 mints (CLONES, wSOL, CARDS, COLLECT).

wSOL market_cap_usd (1.44B) is on-chain wrapped supply, not SOL's market cap.
endpoints.params_limits: Max 30 addresses (swagger); 50 on Analyst+. Unknown addresses are ignored.

endpoints.name: Token info (metadata, holders, security)
endpoints.purpose: Token page sidebar: socials, image, holders count and distribution, GT score, mint/freeze authority, dev wallet and holding %, launchpad graduation.
endpoints.response_shape:
data.attributes:
- Identity: address, name, symbol, decimals.
- Images: image_url; image.{thumb,small,large}; banner_image_url|null.
- Links: coingecko_coin_id; websites[]; discord_url; farcaster_url; zora_url; telegram_handle; twitter_handle (can be malformed, e.g. "davdevsx/status/2104652942892794024"); description|null.
- Scoring: gt_score (float 0-100); gt_score_details.{pool,transaction,creation,info,holders}; gt_verified (bool).
- Categories: categories[] (e.g. "Pump Fun"); gt_category_ids[] (e.g. "pump-fun").
- holders.count: int|null.
- holders.distribution_percentage.{top_10,11_20,21_40,rest}: percent strings, or null. Solana buckets; other chains use 11_30/31_50.
- holders.last_updated: ISO|null. All holders fields are null for brand-new tokens.
- Security: mint_authority "yes"|"no" (STRING); freeze_authority "yes"|"no"; is_honeypot "unknown" (no honeypot data on Solana).
- Dev: developer_address; developer_holding_percentage (string percent).
- launchpad_details: {graduation_percentage (e.g. 1.61 for a live pump-fun curve, 100 when graduated), completed, completed_at, migrated_destination_pool_address}.
endpoints.params_limits: 1 token per call (the pool info endpoint gives 2).
endpoints.freshness: Cache 60 s. holders.last_updated was ~3.3 min old at fetch.

endpoints.name: Pool tokens info
endpoints.purpose: Metadata and security for both tokens of a pair in one call, plus GT community sentiment.
endpoints.response_shape:
data[]: 2 token objects, each with the full token-info attribute set. Order is NOT base-first; wSOL came first. Each has relationships.pool.

included[] pool: attributes {base_token_address, quote_token_address, sentiment_vote_positive_percentage, sentiment_vote_negative_percentage, community_sus_report}.
endpoints.params_limits: include: pool.

endpoints.name: Top pools by token
endpoints.purpose: Pick the main pool for a token (chart and trades source). Shows launch pool, migration pool and third-party pools.
endpoints.response_shape: Pool list shape. Example for CLONES: pumpswap CnJY... (liq 84.9k), meteora-damm-v2 GG6M... (the migration destination, liq 10.7), meteora-dbc FFJa... (liq 0.0).
endpoints.params_limits: 20 per page, 10 pages. Default sort h24_volume_usd_liquidity_desc.

endpoints.name: Search pools
endpoints.purpose: Global search box.
endpoints.response_shape: Pool list shape, 20 per page. query=CLONES returned CLONES/SOL pumpswap pools, CATCLONES and a meteora pool, i.e. fuzzy symbol/name matching.
endpoints.params_limits: 20 per page, max 10 pages. Matches pool address, token name, symbol or mint.

endpoints.name: Pool OHLCV (minute/hour/day)
endpoints.purpose: Candlestick chart on token pages.
endpoints.response_shape:
data.id (uuid). data.type "ohlcv_request_response".

data.attributes.ohlcv_list: array of [timestamp_unix_SECONDS int, open, high, low, close, volume], all JSON numbers (floats).
- Sorted NEWEST FIRST; reverse for charting libraries.
- Prices in USD when currency=usd; volume is USD.

meta.base and meta.quote: {name, symbol, coingecko_coin_id, address}.
endpoints.params_limits:
- aggregate: minute 1/5/15; hour 1/4/12; day 1.
- aggregate=2 returns 400 "Invalid aggregate. Allowed values: 1, 5, 15".
- limit max 1000 (default 100); limit=1001 returns 400 "Invalid limit. must be positive integer less than or equal to 1000".
- Each call covers at most a 6-month range: day/limit=1000 returned only 184 candles. Page back with before_timestamp (the earliest ts).
- Keyless reached at least 6.5 months back (verified). Docs: Basic = past 6 months; Analyst+ = from Sept 2021.
- Empty intervals are skipped unless include_empty_intervals=true (then OHLC = previous close, volume 0).
- timeframe=second on keyless returns 401 (see the separate entry).
endpoints.freshness: At 20:46:00 the newest candle was the 20:45 minute; the current minute is often absent. Cache: public 60 s, paid 10 s.

endpoints.name: Pool OHLCV second timeframe
endpoints.purpose: 1s/15s/30s candles for a pump-style fast chart.
endpoints.response_shape: Same ohlcv_list shape as the minute/hour/day endpoint.
endpoints.params_limits: aggregate 1/15/30. Paid plans only. The live keyless call to api.geckoterminal.com returned HTTP 401 {"errors":[{"status":"401","title":"timeframe=second is exclusive to Paid plan subscribers only. Upgrade to Analyst plan & above ..."}]}.
endpoints.auth: x-cg-pro-api-key, Analyst plan and above (per the live error text)

endpoints.name: Pool trades (last 300 / 24h)
endpoints.purpose: Snapshot of the live transaction feed on the trade page; maker wallets for a wallet-activity overlay.
endpoints.response_shape:
data[] (NEWEST FIRST, up to 300, no meta on keyless):
- id: "solana_<block>_<signature>_<index>_<unix-ts-ish>"; the suffix is undocumented.
- type: "trade".
- attributes.block_number: int, Solana slot.
- attributes.block_timestamp: ISO UTC, seconds.
- attributes.tx_hash: signature.
- attributes.tx_from_address: signer/maker wallet.
- attributes.kind: "buy"|"sell", relative to the token param (default base).
- attributes.from_token_address / to_token_address: mints.
- attributes.from_token_amount / to_token_amount: DECIMAL-ADJUSTED strings, e.g. "4.911028452" SOL.
- attributes.price_from_in_usd / price_to_in_usd: USD per token, strings.
- attributes.price_from_in_currency_token / price_to_in_currency_token: price in quote token.
- attributes.volume_in_usd: string with ~60 decimals.

Paid responses add meta.next_cursor.
endpoints.params_limits:
- Keyless/Demo/Basic: last 300 trades within 24 h. On a hot pool 300 trades covered only 45 s (20:44:19 to 20:45:04).
- trade_volume_in_usd_greater_than=1000 returned 37 trades, all at least 1004 USD.
- trading_period (1d/7d/30d), cursor and per_page (1-300) are Analyst+ only.
endpoints.freshness: Newest block_timestamp was 33 s old at fetch (MISS). Cache-Control s-maxage=30. Paid: real-time (no cache).

endpoints.name: Simple token price
endpoints.purpose: Cheap batch pricing for portfolio/PnL valuation and watchlists.
endpoints.response_shape:
data.id (uuid). data.type "simple_token_price".

data.attributes maps, each keyed by mint -> string:
- token_prices (USD).
- market_cap_usd (FDV when mcap_fdv_fallback=true).
- h24_volume_usd.
- h24_price_change_percentage.
- total_reserve_in_usd.

Missing mints are silently omitted.
endpoints.params_limits: Up to 30 addresses keyless/Demo; 100 on Analyst+. Price comes from GT's chosen best pool.

endpoints.name: Recently updated token info
endpoints.purpose: Detect tokens whose socials or image just got updated (e.g. a 'DEX paid / socials updated' badge).
endpoints.response_shape: data[100]: token objects with attributes {address, name, symbol, decimals, image_url, coingecko_coin_id, websites, discord_url, farcaster_url, zora_url, telegram_handle, twitter_handle, description, gt_score, metadata_updated_at (ISO)} and relationships.network. included[]: network.
endpoints.params_limits: Fixed 100 items.

endpoints.name: Megafilter for pools
endpoints.purpose: Best paid source for Pulse columns (fresh pools per launchpad, filtered) and a server-side Discover screener.
endpoints.response_shape: Pool list shape (data[], included[]), 20 per page.
endpoints.params_limits:
- sort: m5/h1/h6/h24_trending (default h6_trending); h24_tx_count asc/desc; h24_volume_usd asc/desc; {m5,h1,h6,h24}_price_change_percentage asc/desc; fdv_usd asc/desc; reserve_in_usd asc/desc; price asc/desc; pool_created_at_desc.
- Min/max filters: fdv_usd, reserve_in_usd, h24_volume_usd, pool_created_hour, tx_count/buys/sells (with a 5m/1h/6h/24h duration each), price_change_percentage (with a duration), buy/sell tax, holder_count, top_10_holders_percentage.
- checks: no_honeypot, good_gt_score (>=75), on_coingecko, has_social. Honeypot data is not supported for Solana.
- dexes only works with a single network.
- Public GT /pools/megafilter returned 401 Unauthorized (verified).

endpoints.name: Trending search pools
endpoints.purpose: 'Most searched' strip.
endpoints.response_shape: Pool list shape. Cross-network.
endpoints.params_limits: pools max 10 (default 4). Public GT /pools/trending_search returned 401 (verified).

endpoints.name: Top token holders
endpoints.purpose: Holders tab: top wallets, % of supply, optional per-holder PnL. Bundle/insider heuristics.
endpoints.response_shape:
data.id "solana_<mint>". data.type "top_holder". data.attributes.last_updated_at (ISO ms).

data.attributes.holders[]:
- rank; address; label|null.
- amount: decimal-adjusted string.
- percentage: percent string.
- value: USD string.
- average_buy_price_usd; total_buy_count; total_sell_count.
- unrealized_pnl_usd; unrealized_pnl_percentage; realized_pnl_usd; realized_pnl_percentage (null unless include_pnl_details).
- explorer_url (solscan).
endpoints.params_limits: Max 40 holders for Solana (50 on other chains). Beta. Public GT path returned 401 (verified).

endpoints.name: Historical token holders chart
endpoints.purpose: Holder-count sparkline or chart on the token page.
endpoints.response_shape:
data.id (uuid). data.type "token_holders_snapshot".

data.attributes.token_holders_list: [[ISO timestamp string, holder_count int], ...].

meta.token: {name, symbol, coingecko_coin_id, address}.
endpoints.params_limits: days 7 = all points; 30 = daily; max = weekly. Beta. Solana supported.

endpoints.name: Top token traders
endpoints.purpose: Top Traders tab; seed list for the wallet tracker; smart-money discovery.
endpoints.response_shape:
data.id "solana_<mint>". data.type "top_trader".

data.attributes.traders[]:
- address; name; label; type.
- realized_pnl_usd; unrealized_pnl_usd; token_balance.
- average_buy_price_usd; average_sell_price_usd.
- total_buy_count; total_sell_count.
- total_buy_token_amount; total_sell_token_amount (decimal-adjusted).
- total_buy_usd; total_sell_usd.
- explorer_url.

USD values are long-precision strings.
endpoints.params_limits: Max 50 traders. Only tokens created after 2023-09-01. No stables or wSOL. Beta.

endpoints.name: Trades by token (all pools) and trades/range
endpoints.purpose: Unified token trade feed across pumpswap, meteora and other pools; history backfill; wallet-activity reconstruction.
endpoints.response_shape:
data[] uses the same attributes as pool trades, plus pool_address and pool_dex.

meta.next_cursor: string|null. Pass it back unchanged; an invalid or expired cursor returns 400.
endpoints.params_limits: per_page max 300 (range default 100). Range window max 30 days, inclusive, not in the future.

endpoints.name: Token OHLCV by token address
endpoints.purpose: Chart by mint without choosing a pool. Uses the most liquid pool, so it can switch after migration.
endpoints.response_shape: Same ohlcv_list shape as pool OHLCV.
endpoints.params_limits: Same aggregates as pool OHLCV, including second 1/15/30. Max 1000 candles, 6-month range per call.

endpoints.name: Wallet trades / wallet PnL
endpoints.purpose: Wallet tracker and wallet PnL analytics.
endpoints.response_shape:
Trades: data[] with trade attributes plus pool_address and pool_dex; meta.next_cursor.

PnL: data.attributes:
- wallet_address; total_realized_pnl_usd; total_unrealized_pnl_usd; total_tokens.
- networks[] {network, realized_pnl_usd, unrealized_pnl_usd, tokens}.
- token_stats[] {network, address, name, symbol, decimals, realized_pnl_usd, unrealized_pnl_usd, average_buy_price_usd, average_sell_price_usd, total_buy_count, total_sell_count, total_buy_token_amount, total_sell_token_amount, total_buy_usd, total_sell_usd}.
endpoints.params_limits:
- Trades from/to window max 30 days; default last 7 days.
- PnL: networks in one call must share a VM family.
- Docs examples are EVM only and there is no Solana support list, so Solana support is UNCERTAIN. Test with a key before relying on it.
- The sibling wallet balances and transfers endpoints list only EVM networks (eth, base, bsc, polygon_pos, arbitrum, optimism, avax, stable, robinhood, linea, arc): NOT Solana.
endpoints.freshness: trades real-time; PnL 60 s; balances 10 s

endpoints.name: On-chain categories / pools by category
endpoints.purpose: Launchpad and category boards (token info exposes gt_category_ids such as "pump-fun").
endpoints.response_shape: Pool list shape for the pools-by-category call.
endpoints.params_limits: Analyst+.

endpoints.name: CoinGecko on-chain base (Demo/Pro hosts) without key
endpoints.purpose: Confirms that keyless access only works on api.geckoterminal.com.
endpoints.response_shape:
- api.coingecko.com: 401 {"status":{"timestamp":ISO,"error_code":401,"error_message":"Requests without API key are not allowed for this endpoint..."}}.
- pro-api: 401 {"status":{"error_code":10002,"error_message":"API Key Missing"}}.
- With a key, paths map 1:1: GT /api/v2/X equals CG /api/v3/onchain/X, same JSON:API bodies.
endpoints.params_limits: n/a

streaming.name: OnchainTrade (channel G2)
streaming.status: DOCUMENTED (paid Basic+; beta, no SLA; not live-tested, no key)
streaming.auth: CoinGecko paid key (Basic $35/mo and up). Browser WebSocket cannot set headers, so the key would sit in the URL; needs a server relay.
streaming.event_shape: {c:"G2", n:network_id, pa:pool_address, tx:tx_hash, ty:"b"|"s", to:base_token_amount (number), toq:quote_token_amount (number), vo:volume_in_usd, pc:price_in_native_currency, pu:price_in_usd, t:last_updated_at UNIX MILLISECONDS}. Keys may arrive in any order; fields can be null.
streaming.notes: Updates as fast as ~0.1 s. The payload has NO maker wallet (tx_from_address) and no block number, so it cannot feed the wallet tracker or maker column alone; enrich via REST or RPC. 100 pool subscriptions per channel per socket. 5 sockets on Basic, 10 on Analyst+. 0.1 credit per message, so a busy pool (~16k tx/h observed) is about 1.6k credits/h. Server pings every 10 s and drops the connection with no pong in 20 s; reconnect with backoff (deploys disconnect). Vercel functions cannot hold this socket; use a persistent relay (e.g. Fly/Railway/Cloudflare Durable Object) that fans out to browsers.

streaming.name: OnchainOHLCV (channel G3)
streaming.event_shape: {ch:"G3", n, pa, to:"base"|"quote", i:interval, o, h, l, c (USD numbers), v:volume USD, t:candle open time UNIX SECONDS}
streaming.notes: Intervals: 1s, 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 8h, 12h, 1d. Updates as fast as ~1 s. Each interval+token combination per pool counts as a separate subscription (100 per channel per socket). Use it to live-update the last candle after seeding history from REST OHLCV.

streaming.name: OnchainSimpleTokenPrice (channel G1)
streaming.event_shape: {c:"G1", n, ta:token_address, p:usd_price, pp:usd_price_24h_change_percentage, m:usd_market_cap, v:usd_24h_vol, t:last_updated_at UNIX SECONDS}
streaming.notes: Price comes from the token's top pool. Updates as fast as ~1 s. Good for live watchlist or portfolio values. No keyless or Demo WebSocket exists; the WebSocket docs say paid Basic plan and above.

orbyt_fit: Discover token table: trending_pools (duration 5m/1h/6h/24h) and networks/solana/pools (sort h24_volume_usd_desc or h24_tx_count_desc) give real price, FDV/MC, liquidity, per-window volume, buys/sells/buyers/sellers and price change. Refresh visible rows with pools/multi (30 per call keyless, 50 on Analyst+). Keyless: call from the browser (CORS *) and stay within ~10/min per user. Paid: megafilter with sort and filters behind a Next.js route with s-maxage caching.

Token metadata: tokens/{mint}/info or pools/{pool}/info (both tokens) supplies image (thumb/small/large), websites, twitter/telegram/discord, description, categories/gt_category_ids and gt_verified. Metadata is unvetted unless gt_verified.

Price: pool detail base_token_price_usd/_native_currency; batch prices via simple/networks/solana/token_price (30 keyless/Demo, 100 Analyst+) or tokens/multi; live via WS OnchainSimpleTokenPrice (paid).
Liquidity: reserve_in_usd; include_composition gives per-side token balances and USD; locked_liquidity_percentage (daily); token total_reserve_in_usd across pools.

Trades feed: pools/{pool}/trades gives the latest 300 trades (24 h) with maker wallet (tx_from_address), kind, amounts and USD volume, 30-60 s stale on keyless. Real-time needs paid: pool trades with no cache on paid REST, or WS OnchainTrade (~0.1 s, but no maker wallet). Token-level cross-pool trades: tokens/{mint}/trades (Analyst+).

Chart: pools/{pool}/ohlcv minute(1,5,15)/hour(1,4,12)/day(1), max 1000 candles and a 6-month window per call, page with before_timestamp. 1s/15s/30s candles need Analyst+ (REST timeframe=second) or WS OnchainOHLCV (1s..1d, Basic+).

Pulse New Pairs: networks/solana/new_pools includes pump.fun bonding curves (dex id pump-fun), meteora-dbc, stonkfun, pumpswap and meteora-damm-v2. Keyless is only a delayed sampler (~40 s lag; 20 rows = ~12-30 s of launches; 10 pages max). Proper Pulse needs Analyst+ megafilter (sort=pool_created_at_desc, dexes=pump-fun,meteora-dbc,raydium-launchlab,letsbonk-fun,bags-fm..., pool_created_hour_max, holder/top10 filters) or a direct on-chain source.

Pulse Final Stretch: batch candidate bonding pools (from new_pools or dexes/pump-fun/pools) into pools/multi, which returns launchpad_details.graduation_percentage (0-100), completed and completed_at. Sort by graduation_percentage; 30 pools per keyless call.

Pulse Migrated: launchpad_details.completed=true plus completed_at and migrated_destination_pool_address (pools/multi, tokens, token info). Migration destination pools (pumpswap, meteora-damm-v2) also show up in new_pools, and dexes/pumpswap/pools lists graduated pools.

Holders and risk: token info holders.count, top_10/11_20/21_40/rest distribution, mint_authority/freeze_authority (strings), developer_address and developer_holding_percentage, gt_score and gt_score_details, and community sentiment/sus reports via pool info include=pool. Honeypot is 'unknown' on Solana. Paid Analyst+: top_holders (40 max, PnL optional) and holders_chart.

Wallet tracker and wallet activity: keyless gives only tx_from_address inside per-pool trade snapshots. Analyst+ adds top_traders per token (PnL, balances, labels) and wallet trades/PnL endpoints, whose Solana support is UNCERTAIN. Wallet balances/transfers are EVM-only, so Solana portfolio needs RPC/Helius.
Quotes/swaps: NOT provided (no route or quote endpoint); use Jupiter or similar.
Portfolio valuation: simple token_price or tokens/multi for pricing mints held (balances must come from Solana RPC).
gotchas: The keyless rate limit is ~10 calls/min per IP and fluctuates; 429s were observed after 5-6 calls in ~40 s. There are no X-RateLimit headers and Retry-After is 0. Errors and 429s count toward the limit. Keyless calls from Vercel server functions share cloud egress IPs with other tenants, so do not rely on them server-side.

The 429 response has no access-control-allow-origin header, so in the browser fetch() rejects with a TypeError, not a readable 429. Treat network errors from api.geckoterminal.com as rate limiting and back off exponentially.

Everything is cached: Cache-Control max-age=30, s-maxage=60 (trades s-maxage=30) plus Cloudflare cf-cache-status and age headers. Measured staleness: newest trade 33 s, newest new pool 40-44 s. Docs say public data refreshes about every 60 s; paid is 10-30 s and trades/simple price are real-time on paid. Do not label keyless data 'live'.
The docs say the current version is 20230203 (swagger), not 20230302. Send Accept: application/json;version=20230203. The API is still called 'v2-beta' and may change.
apiguide.geckoterminal.com is dead (403 'The organization has been suspended'). Use https://api.geckoterminal.com/docs/v2/swagger.json and docs.coingecko.com (llms.txt) instead.

Numbers are strings with huge precision (e.g. volume_in_usd has 60+ decimals; wSOL total_reserve_in_usd has 150+ digits). Parse with a decimal library or Number() and format; never feed them to JSON number fields directly.

Units: trade token amounts and pool token balances are decimal-adjusted strings. token.total_supply is RAW base units ("1000000000000000.0") while normalized_total_supply is adjusted. Prices *_native_currency are in SOL; price_*_in_currency_token is in the pool's quote token. OHLCV volume is USD when currency=usd; volume units with currency=token are unverified.

Timestamps: pool_created_at and block_timestamp are ISO-8601 UTC at second precision; launchpad completed_at has milliseconds; OHLCV timestamps are unix SECONDS; WS OnchainTrade t is MILLISECONDS; WS OHLCV and token-price t are SECONDS.

OHLCV lists are newest-first and must be reversed for lightweight-charts or TradingView. Gaps are skipped unless include_empty_intervals=true. The in-progress minute may be missing. limit is capped at 1000 but a single call covers at most 6 months (day candles returned only 184). Only aggregates 1/5/15 (minute), 1/4/12 (hour) and 1 (day) are allowed; others return 400. timeframe=second returns 401 without an Analyst+ key.

Trades endpoint (keyless) returns only the last 300 trades within 24 h. On a hot pump token that is only ~45 s of history, and there is no pagination without Analyst+ (cursor/per_page/trading_period). kind is relative to the token param (default base).
market_cap_usd is null for unverified tokens (most memecoins); use fdv_usd with mcap_fdv_fallback. wSOL's market_cap_usd is on-chain wrapped supply (~1.44B), not SOL's market cap.

mint_authority, freeze_authority and is_honeypot are strings ("yes"/"no"/"unknown"), not booleans. is_honeypot is always 'unknown' on Solana. holders.* are null for brand-new tokens, and holder data is beta (last_updated was ~3 min old).

launchpad_details (graduation %) appears only in pool detail, pools/multi, token, tokens/multi and token info. It does NOT appear in new_pools, trending, top pools or dex pools lists, so Final Stretch needs an extra pools/multi call per 30 pools.

pools/info returns data[] with both tokens and the order is not base-first (wSOL came first); match on address against the pool's base_token_address in included. Multi endpoints drop unknown addresses silently; match by id rather than by index.
IDs are prefixed: pool/token ids are 'solana_<address>'; relationships use these prefixed ids while attributes.address is bare. Trade ids have an undocumented trailing numeric suffix.

Launch-to-migration flows create several pools per token (e.g. meteora-dbc then meteora-damm-v2, plus third-party pumpswap pools). The most liquid pool can differ from launchpad_details.migrated_destination_pool_address, so pick the chart pool via tokens/{mint}/pools sort=h24_volume_usd_liquidity_desc.
twitter_handle can contain junk (e.g. 'user/status/<id>'); sanitize before building URLs.

Keyless api.coingecko.com/onchain returns 401; only api.geckoterminal.com is keyless. Demo keys give 100/min but only 10k calls/month (~333/day), which is unsuitable for multi-user production beyond prototyping.

Paid WebSocket keys go in the query string (browsers cannot set WS headers), so never connect from the browser with a paid key; a persistent relay outside Vercel functions is required. OnchainTrade events lack the maker wallet.
Wallet balances/transfers do not support Solana (EVM list only); wallet trades/PnL Solana support is unconfirmed. Top traders exclude tokens created before 2023-09-01, stablecoins and wSOL.
Vary: Accept, Origin means cache entries differ per Origin and per Accept header. Keep one exact Accept string app-wide to maximize Cloudflare HITs (a HIT was served in 27 ms with age:3).

Request budget note: ~44 calls were made to api.geckoterminal.com during testing (including 429 retries); later probes kept returning 429 even after 2+ minutes idle, possibly because of other traffic on the same IP.
terms_and_risks:
- Attribution: CoinGecko's attribution guide asks free API users to show the GeckoTerminal/CoinGecko logo with a link and the text "On-chain data powered by/provided by GeckoTerminal" near the data (https://brand.coingecko.com/resources/attribution-guide).
- Redistribution: the pricing page lists a "commercial redistribution license" only for Enterprise. Displaying data inside a public trading terminal is fine per attribution guidance, but any resale or bulk re-export of raw data needs review of the API Terms (https://www.coingecko.com/en/api_terms). Confirm ORBYT's commercial display use with CoinGecko before launch.
- The public API is beta, has no SLA, and its limits fluctuate. The WebSocket is beta and excluded from the SLA. Holders, top holders and top traders data are beta.
- Token metadata (image, socials, description) is user-submitted and unvetted unless gt_verified; label it accordingly to avoid showing scam links as endorsed.
- Honeypot checks are unsupported on Solana; don't present 'is_honeypot: unknown' as safe.
- Operational risk: the keyless per-IP limit plus 30-60 s caching cannot support a real-time Axiom-style terminal. Production needs at least a paid CoinGecko plan: Analyst ($129/mo, 500k credits, 500/min) for megafilter, second candles, holders, traders and token trades; WebSocket from Basic ($35/mo), 0.1 credit per message. Plan for credit burn from streaming hot pools, and for a non-Vercel relay.
- Keys must stay server-side, never NEXT_PUBLIC_. The docs warn against query-string keys in production.
